title: _gqa_kernel_prefill_g2stack_flat — flat cross-task 4-phase pipeline (kv_iters==1 specialization)

final_gqa_py.diff_vs_backup: 2 pure-insert hunks: +453 lines (kernel factory after _gqa_kernel_prefill_g2stack) and +38 lines (dispatch gate before the g2stack spec); ZERO lines of existing kernels modified

deviations_from_blueprint: GATE NARROWED: task-spec/blueprint gate 'kv_iters<=2' implemented as 'kv_iters==1'. Rationale: the flat kernel is a kv==1 specialization (flattened stream degenerates to the task sequence; kv_useful==1 provable for every task so the causal block-skip machinery is unnecessary); kv==2 shapes already get the g2stack ns=2 intra-task batch stagger (measured -28.6%/kv in iter1) and flattening a variable-length 2*mc stream with per-task causal variation is a different, unbuilt/unvalidated change. kv==2 dispatch is UNCHANGED (g2stack).

V-side fill strategy: iter2 first attempt removed per-task fills (self-reset via r_factors underflow) — bit-identical for finite inputs but leaked NaN/Inf across same-parity tasks (boundary_sparse_special WARN nan_pos_mismatch=512). FIXED by restoring per-task zero-fills of acc_o/sumexp parity slots at AO(x) head (V-order-safe: previous same-parity reader FIN(x-2) ran two beats earlier). Post-fix: 24/24 suite PASS and bit-identical preserved.
q_l1 double-buffering NOT added (local event ids 6/7 hardware-reserved; MTE1<->MTE2 id space 0-5 full) — single-slot q_l1 with Qload(x+2) prefetch issued inside loop step x, as blueprinted.

Cross-semaphores kept SINGLE counting (ids 0-5, no parity split): the merged pacing stall (G1(x) WS1_V2C wait == SM(x-1) done) is beat-aligned with G2(x-1)'s WS2_V2C wait, so parity splitting buys nothing (beat algebra in the variant module docstring).

structure.C_scope: prologue Qload(0),G1(0),Qload(1); steady loop t=0..mc-3: G1(t+1)->G2(t)->Qload(t+2); epilogue G2(mc-2),G1(mc-1),G2(mc-1); alloc_var-bound epilogue indices (xc1/xc2)
structure.V_scope: init static fills (acc_o/sumexp/neg_sm cap); prologue SM(0),SM(1); steady loop jj=0..mc-3: AO(jj)->FIN(jj)->SM(jj+2); epilogue AO/FIN(mc-2), AO/FIN(mc-1); alloc_var-bound epilogue indices (xv1/xv2)
structure.offset: AO(x) runs 2 V-beats after SM(x+1)... concretely SM(x)->G2(x)->AO(x) chain gets >=1 full beat (~2.9us) slack (offset-3 design point; offset-1/2 expose ~0.8us G2 latency per beat)
structure.onchip_budget: L0A/L0B/L0C unchanged (exactly at envelopes); L1 unchanged 192KB/512KB; UB ~155KB/192KB (+32KB acc_o parity +0.5KB sumexp/is/rf vs shipped)
